related_questions.question: Is 1288L better than 1257L?
related_questions.snippet: What is the difference between Tax Code 1288l vs 1257l? Employees' tax code changes to 1288L when they claim the £6 weekly working-from-home allowance. The only difference between tax code 1288L and 1257L is that you can earn up to £12,880 without paying income tax with the code 1288L.
